<table cellspacing="0" class="t_table" style="width:98%"><tbody><tr><td><div align="center"><font style="color:rgb(153, 153, 153)"><font style="font-size:12px">本帖最后由 xexing 于 2026-10-5 04:06 编辑</font></font></div><br>
<br>
起因：我设置的DSH 会话的工作区是 C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop，导致workspace-write 沙箱在工作区上打了常驻授权：能力 SID 允许 ACE + Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(S,DC) + Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)，于是 Desktop 整棵子树里的文件都继承了 Low 完整性标签。<br>
当我启动我正常的程序时直接弹窗：&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;<img id="aimg_I3LWr" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" width="391" height="172" file="https://cdn-bbs.huorong.cn/data/attachment/forum/202610/05/035628knlo3avts90tn777.png" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn-bbs.huorong.cn/data/attachment/forum/202610/05/035628knlo3avts90tn777.png"> <img id="aimg_l96Du" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" width="301" height="172" file="https://cdn-bbs.huorong.cn/data/attachment/forum/202610/05/040615irriramuziv97rtx.png" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn-bbs.huorong.cn/data/attachment/forum/202610/05/040615irriramuziv97rtx.png"><br>
<br>
<br>
进程完整性不能高于其镜像文件的完整性标签。我即使在高完整性的 cmd 里启动，进程也会被降到 Low： <img id="aimg_E65qf" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" width="600" height="314" file="https://cdn-bbs.huorong.cn/data/attachment/forum/202610/05/040220ekstsbs7ps4l237r.png" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn-bbs.huorong.cn/data/attachment/forum/202610/05/040220ekstsbs7ps4l237r.png"><br>
<br>
Low 进程按 No-Write-Up 规则，写不了任何 Medium 标签的位置：%TEMP%、ProgramData、Documents、磁盘根 → CreateDirectoryW 返回 5 拒绝访问<br>
PyInstaller 引导器只会报 Could not create temporary directory!；.NET 的 OpenTrace 则是 0xE0434352<br>
<br>
<br>
最后我运行了这三个命令才搞好:<br>
icacls "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop" /setintegritylevel (OI)(CI)M /T /C&nbsp; &nbsp; （将标签恢复成 Medium）<br>
icacls "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop" /remove:d Everyone /T /C<br>
icacls "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop" /remove "S-1-4-1039366120-933337351" /T /C&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;（清掉沙箱留下的拒绝项和能力 SID 授权）<br>
</td></tr></tbody></table></td></tr></tbody></table>
